$comment: Mirrored from the ticket tool in Jira's shapes: a project's browse permission says who sees its issues, and an issue with a security level is seen only by that level's members and its reporter.

issues.summary: Payout to Aldermoor Bakery failed twice
issues.description:
Aldermoor Bakery's weekly payout failed on 2 and 9 October.

The bank returned code AC04, account closed, for the IBAN ending 4471. The customer changed banks in September and did not update Copperline.

Next step: Support asks the customer to add the new account, then Payouts reruns both payouts.

issues.summary: Customer asks for a CSV export of all invoices
issues.description:
Nordlicht Studios wants every invoice since 2023 as one CSV file.

The export page caps at 12 months. Engineering can run a one-off export with the invoices-export job.

Agreed to send it by 20 October.

issues.summary: Admin API has no rate limit on payout export
issues.description:
Pen test finding from Northgate Security, rated CVSS 8.1.

The admin endpoint /v1/payouts/export has no rate limit, so a stolen admin token can pull every payout in minutes.

Fix due 30 October: 10 requests per minute per token, and an alert on any export over 5,000 rows.

issues.summary: SOC 2 Type II access review evidence
issues.description:
Evidence for the SOC 2 Type II access review, shared with the auditors from Kessler Audit.

The review found 3 orphaned admin accounts in the payouts console, belonging to people who left in 2025. All three were removed on 3 October.

The auditors need the removal log and the quarterly review sign-off by 31 October.

issues.summary: Expense review: Berlin offsite hotel claims
issues.description:
Review of hotel claims from the Berlin offsite in September.

The expense tool flagged 2,340 euros of hotel nights claimed twice, once on a card and once as a receipt.

Outcome: an honest mistake from a booking tool export. The duplicate amount was reversed in the October payroll.
